builds.title: Roofline courier, Gecko Monk 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Dexterity save +4. HP is 8 + 2 Constitution. Natural Armor and Monk Unarmored Defense each give AC 13.
Outlander grants Athletics, Survival, Draconic and Wanderer. Monk grants Acrobatics and Insight. Carries no wielded gear.
Spider Climb lets Bramblepad travel along difficult walls or ceilings without an ability check. No hands for weapons, shields or other hand-dependent gear.
actions: Bite. Strength-based melee unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 piercing.

Martial Arts. After a bite made with the Attack action, make one ordinary kick as a bonus action, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 bludgeoning. The supplement reserves bonus-action strikes for ordinary unarmed blows.
builds.tactics: Bramblepad takes the ceiling route when Hush Market’s alleys fill up and drops to defend a cornered traveler.

builds.title: Drainage scout, Rogue 2
builds.senses: Passive Perception 15, or 20 for smell-based details when advantage applies.
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5, Intelligence save +3. Unarmored AC 10 + 3 Dexterity. HP is 8 + 2 at level 1 and 5 + 2 at level 2.

Criminal grants Deception, Stealth, Thieves’ Tools and Criminal Contact. Rogue adds Acrobatics, Insight, Investigation and Perception. Expertise applies to Perception and Stealth. Cobbledot carries no gear.
Keen Smell gives advantage on Perception checks using smell. Unable to wield weapons or shields.
actions: Bite. Dexterity-based melee unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 piercing. Its finesse trait makes it eligible for Sneak Attack.
Sneak Attack. Once per turn add 1d6 piercing to a bite with advantage. It also applies when a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of the target and Cobbledot has no disadvantage.
Pack Tactics. Bonus action to give the next attack roll this turn advantage if the target is within 5 ft. of a non-incapacitated ally.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Cobbledot gets close by using cover and bites only when a nearby companion can threaten the same foe.

builds.title: Salvage guard, Barbarian 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Constitution save +4. Natural Armor and Barbarian Unarmored Defense each give AC 14. HP is 12 + 2 Constitution.
Outlander grants Athletics, Survival, Dwarvish and Wanderer. Barbarian grants Nature and Perception. Wields neither weapons nor shield.
Claw damage type uses a table ruling of bludgeoning because the trait gives the attack die without a type.
actions: Claw. Strength-based melee unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 bludgeoning, or 1d8+5 while raging.

Seize. After an Attack-action claw hits, use a bonus action to grapple the target with that claw. Keelpin rolls Athletics +5 against the target’s Athletics or Acrobatics, its choice. The target must be Large or smaller. Keelpin rolls with advantage while raging.
Sting. Strength-based melee unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 piercing plus 1d4 poison, or 1d4+5 piercing plus 1d4 poison while raging.

Rage. Bonus action, two per long rest, for up to 1 minute. Gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, and +2 damage to Strength-based melee weapon attacks. It ends early on unconsciousness, if willingly ended as a bonus action, or if a turn ends without an attack against a hostile creature or damage taken since the last turn.
builds.tactics: Keelpin takes hold of a moving foe to keep it away from the salvagers and stings only when a hold will do little good.

builds.title: Mooring runner, Barbarian 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Constitution save +3. Natural Armor and Barbarian Unarmored Defense each give AC 13. HP is 12 + 1 Constitution.
Sailor grants Athletics, Perception, navigator’s tools, water vehicles and Ship’s Passage. Barbarian grants Animal Handling and Survival. Siltcrest travels underwater and carries no gear.
Can only breathe underwater. Cannot wield weapons or use shields.
actions: Ram. Strength-based melee unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 bludgeoning, or 1d8+5 while raging. A Dexterity ram is +4 for 1d8+2 bludgeoning.
Charge. Once per turn after swimming at least 15 ft. toward a creature, a Strength-based ram hit against that creature adds 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

Rage. Bonus action, two per long rest, for up to 1 minute. Gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, and +2 damage to Strength-based melee weapon attacks. It ends early on unconsciousness, if willingly ended as a bonus action, or if a turn ends without an attack against a hostile creature or damage taken since the last turn.
builds.tactics: Siltcrest swings wide around the mooring so a charging ram can drive a threat away from the rope.

builds.title: Lookout, Monk 1
builds.senses: Passive Perception 13, or 18 for sight or smell when advantage applies.
builds.languages: Reads and understands Common. Cannot speak.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Dexterity save +4. Monk Unarmored Defense gives AC 13. HP is 8 + 2 Constitution.
Sailor grants Athletics, Perception, navigator’s tools, water vehicles and Ship’s Passage. Monk grants Acrobatics and Insight. Travels without equipment.
Keen Sight and Smell gives advantage on Perception checks using sight or smell. Medium or heavy armor would prevent flight. Cannot use weapons, shields or hand-dependent items.
actions: Bite. Strength-based melee unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 piercing.
Martial Arts. After a bite made with the Attack action, make an ordinary kick as a bonus action, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 bludgeoning. Use this or Pack Tactics in a turn.
Pack Tactics. Bonus action to give the next attack roll this turn advantage if the target is within 5 ft. of a non-incapacitated ally.
builds.tactics: Shearshade circles once to mark a threat with a wing dip, then lands beside an ally and bites from that angle.

concepts.name: Bramblepad
concepts.role: Carries messages over busy covered markets.
concepts.motive: Find out why a certain rooftop is warm even in winter.
concepts.hook: Three couriers refused the same letter after seeing what moved under the tiles.

concepts.name: Cobbledot
concepts.role: Finds dry routes through storm drains.
concepts.motive: Catch whoever keeps opening the wrong floodgate.
concepts.hook: A drain exhales the smell of fresh bread from a bakery that closed last winter.

concepts.name: Keelpin
concepts.role: Guards a salvage crew while they cut material out of wrecks.
concepts.motive: Buy a share in the crew’s cart with pay it earned.
concepts.hook: The tally scratched onto the axle lists one salvage run Keelpin never worked.

concepts.name: Siltcrest
concepts.role: Checks mooring lines below the wharf.
concepts.motive: Get the night crew to replace a rope before it fails.
concepts.hook: A rope cut overnight has drifted back and tied itself to a different mooring.

concepts.name: Shearshade
concepts.role: Signals dangerous currents to a ferryman.
concepts.motive: Collect enough polished pebbles to mark every safe landing.
concepts.hook: It delivers a pebble marked for a landing that the ferryman has never seen.
